spans.s: (exceptionally n., Daśar. ii, 18/19) a slope, declivity, any part of the body which has (as it were) sloping, sides (cf. श्रोणि-, स्तन-, &c.), a shore, MBh. (said of Śiva, xii, 10381), Hariv. &c. (ifc. f(ई). , Bhartṛ.)
cf. अ-, उत्-; पुर-तटी.
(g. गौरादि,
Gaṇar. 49
) id., Gīt.; Prab.; Sāh.
तट—द्रुम m. a tree standing on the shore.
तट—भू f. the shore, Śiś. viii, 19.
तट—स्थ mfn. standing on a declivity or bank, Naiṣ. iii, 55
= -स्थित, Mālatīm.; Naiṣ. iii, 55
तट—स्थ m. an indifferent person (neither friend nor foe), W.
तट—स्थ n. a property distinct from the nature of the body and yet that by which it is known, spiritual essence, Vedāntak.
तट—स्थित mfn. ‘standing aloof’, indifferent, Uttarar. (said of speech).
the butting (of elephants) against banks &c. (वप्र-क्रीडा), Kum. ii, 50.
a shore, Inscr.
a pool, ṢaḍvBr. v, 12; R. &c.
a large pond, MBh. iii, 279, 44.
Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to appear like a declivity, Alaṃkārav.
‘having a bank’, a river, Rājat. iii, 339; iv, 548; Śatr.
तटिनी—पति m. ‘lord of rivers’, the ocean, i, 50.
living on slopes (Śiva), MBh. xii.
(onomat.) in comp.
तटतट—स्वन mfn. rumbling, thundering, VarBṛS. xxxiii, 5.
(m., L.) n. a kind of ear ornament, Prasannar. ii, 0/1.
decorated with ˚क, iii, 1.
standing aloof, indifference Sch. on KapS. i, 135 and Yogas. i, 33
proximity, W.
